snippet.title: [Unseal] Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
🎮Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4034440/Unseal/

Unseal is a 3rd-person cosmic horror puzzle adventure. You awaken as Ash, a charred figure with a caged head and a fractured past. Navigate a surreal nightmare world built from your own memories, solve maddening puzzles, and evade the grotesque creatures that hunt you.

My friend and I have been working on this for over a year, only your interest and support can help us continue this journey.

Wishlist Unseal on Steam, grateful we are.

🌐Website: https://unseal.fr/

🔊 Audio Credits:
Soundtracks composed by @initialragdoll 
Featuring samples by:

Buttons from Hell - AV-Ylänne
Solo Cello Spurs - Dan Keen
Metal Sails - KevinDePree
Solar Winds - Aila Scott
Tura Lura Lura Music Box - Matthew Saul

Via the Pianobook community.
